mapper.insert: INSERT INTO merchant_interaction (user_id, merchant_id, liked, collected, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{liked}, #{collected}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.business_name as businessName, b.business_img as businessImg, b.start_price as startPrice, b.delivery_price as deliveryPrice, COALESCE(( SELECT AVG(score) FROM orders WHERE business_id = b.id AND score IS NOT NULL ), 0) as score, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE business_id = b.id AND order_state = 3 AND is_deleted = 0 ), 0) as salesCount FROM merchant_interaction mi LEFT JOIN business b ON mi.merchant_id = b.id WHERE mi.user_id = #{userId} AND mi.collected = true AND b.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY mi.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_interaction WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND liked = true
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM merchant_interaction WHERE merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND collected = true
